o: Features a revamped coaching panel consisting of returning veterans Kelly Clarkson and Adam Levine alongside first-time coaches Queen Latifah and country star Riley Green.

eps.o: On the Season Premiere, Kelly Clarkson, Adam Levine, Queen Latifah and Riley Green all vie to discover the next singing phenomenon.
Coaches Kelly Clarkson, Adam Levine, Queen Latifah and Riley Green all vie to discover and coach the next singing phenomenon on the second night of Blind Auditions.
Coaches Kelly Clarkson, Adam Levine, Queen Latifah and Riley Green all vie to discover and coach the next singing phenomenon on the third night of Blind Auditions.
On this 4th night of Blind Auditions, the coaches compete to find and transform America's inspiring voices into music's next phenomenon.
Coaches Queen Latifah, Riley Green, Kelly Clarkson and Adam Levine all vie to discover the next singing phenomenon on the fifth night of Blind Auditions.
Coaches Queen Latifah, Riley Green, Kelly Clarkson and Adam Levine all vie to discover the next singing phenomenon on the sixth and final night of Blind Auditions.
The Battle Rounds begin as the coaches enlist superstar Battle Advisors to help prepare their artists. Coaches will choose the pairings and songs, and each coach has one steal.
The Battle Rounds enter the second night as the coaches enlist superstar Battle Advisors to help prepare their artists. Coaches will choose the pairings and songs, and each coach has one steal.
Each Coach has seven Artists and send two Artists directly to the Live Shows while five compete for one remaining spot, creating the Top 12 before America votes one additional Artist into the Top 13.
